name: stayu
description: StayU - Hospedaje universitario gratuito en Santa Marta

scripts.build: cd services/gateway && npm install && cd ../auth && npm install && cd ../hosts && npm install && cd ../bookings && npm install && cd ../chat && npm install
scripts.install:all: cd services/gateway && npm install && cd ../auth && npm install && cd ../hosts && npm install && cd ../bookings && npm install && cd ../../frontend && npm install
scripts.db:init: docker exec -i stayu_db psql -U postgres -d stayu < database/init.sql
scripts.db:seed: docker exec -i stayu_db psql -U postgres -d stayu < database/seed.sql
